subject: Bivariate regression with dichotomous (probit link) and continuous dependent variables

messages.author: 1f1683909d55a3f5
messages.subject: Bivariate regression with dichotomous (probit link) and continuous dependent variables
parts:
Hi all,

I would like to write a bivariate regression model, in which one of the dependent variables is dichotomous and the other is continuous real valued.

In the attached stan file, I modified the multivariate probit regression code in the section 5.14 of the manual, so that one of the dependent variables (y2) takes any real value.
However, when compiling, it generates the error message: "ERROR(s) during compilation: source code errors or compiler configuration errors!", with long lines of C++ source code.
I never saw it before, and I would appreciate any help/suggestions that could be offered.

Thank you,
Ken

messages.author: cab04b8f0759c712
messages.subject: Re: Bivariate regression with dichotomous (probit link) and continuous dependent variables
parts:
Hi Ken,

Sorry for the delay. This is a bug and I'm filing a bug report.

The problem is that sum is a built into the Stan language and overloading is currently not supported. If you remove the sum function from your functions block, this should work. (it's never used.)


Daniel

Hi Ken, just to let you know, the bug is here: https://github.com/stan-dev/rstan/issues/186

It's an RStan specific bug, not a problem with the Stan language. In other words, your Stan program does work with CmdStan and it should have worked with RStan.


Daniel
